verdict.rationale: LegalZoom documents a personalized dashboard as a centralized hub for updates and documents, a Compliance Calendar with annual-report deadline reminders, real-time compliance-status notifications from state filing offices, and expiration alerts for licenses and registrations. Nothing shows these combined into one portfolio view that lists every entity and state registration with its standing and deadlines, and much of the status and deadline information arrives as email notifications rather than on a dashboard. Missing for 10: evidence of a multi-entity or multi-state portfolio view, per-registration good-standing status shown on the dashboard, deadlines surfaced in the dashboard itself, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
